description: This is the second of a two-part course sequence on artificial intelligence and machine learning. Building on the fundamentals imparted to students in the first course, this course delves into advanced machine learning topics and students will explore topics such as neural networks, ensemble methods and reinforcement learning. The course includes hands-on assignments that involve implementing and fine-tuning models on complex real-world datasets in business and other related domains.
